name: obsidian-skills
description: Obsidian Agent Skills by Xia-Ataraxia: Obsidian-flavoured Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, Mermaid, visual form selection, the official CLI, Web Clipper, vault diagnosis, and vault sync. Version 0.1.0 is unreleased and is registered from a repository or a local path, not from a public plugin directory.

plugins.name: obsidian-skills
plugins.description: Nine self-contained Obsidian Agent Skills. Each skill is a portable SKILL.md package under skills/ with its own references and assets; the plugin is a distribution container only and ships no router, no dispatcher, and no shared runtime.
